subject: Initial MAP kickoff: Rivermark Health — confirm goals & owners
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@rivermarkhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP kickoff: Rivermark Health — confirm goals & owners

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to share a short mutual action plan (MAP) draft and propose a 6-week evaluation cadence so we can converge on success criteria and a realistic path to procurement. The goal of this kickoff email is to: confirm the customer champion, confirm the internal owners for success areas, and lock the high-level timeline.

High-level proposed goals
- Validate Redwood inference on a representative Rivermark dataset (latency and cost targets)
- End-to-end POC with integration to your staging environment
- Completion of security questionnaire and procurement checklist

Proposed 6-week timeline (draft)
1) Week 0: kickoff + roles aligned (this week)
2) Week 1–2: sandbox onboarding + baseline evals
3) Week 3–4: integration + performance tuning
4) Week 5: business review + decision window
5) Week 6: procurement / SOW sign-off (if green)

Action items for you (please confirm)
- Confirm the primary champion who will coordinate internally (product/infra/procurement)
- Identify the technical lead who will own integration tasks
- Any hard constraints on the timeline or security gate dates we should know about

I attached a one-page MAP draft and our standard SOW template to make it easy to iterate. If that looks OK I can send a calendar invite for a 30-min kickoff.

Attachments: Rivermark_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW_template.pdf (Redwood SOW template)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192
--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference runtime

On Sun, May 11, 2025 at 9:12 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Samira —
>
> Thanks again for the time last week... (see below)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for pulling this together. This captures what we discussed and the suggested cadence looks reasonable. I can be the primary champion for the project and will own stakeholder coordination (product and procurement). I’m looping in Elliot (cc) as our technical lead — he will coordinate the staging environment and perf tests. Our procurement team (procurement@rivermarkhealth.com) will need the SOW and standard security checklist; procurement timelines typically require 2 weeks for review after we hand them the docs.

A few clarifications:
- Can we start sandbox access next Tuesday (May 20)? That gives Elliot a week to prep.
- For success criteria, we’d like to validate: 95th percentile latency < 220ms for our typical prompts, and embedding cost per 1k below $X (we can provide token estimates).
- On the SOW: please remove Redwood’s NDA clause in section 4.2 and we’ll share our standard redline.

I’ll confirm Elliot’s availability for the kickoff — but tentatively Tuesday 5/20 at 11:00am PT works for us.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Director of Product Operations | Rivermark Health
samira.khan@rivermarkhealth.com | +1 415-555-0123

- SOW: Laura will prepare a redline-friendly SOW and upload to the Drive link below. We’ll leave the NDA clause editable for your legal team to propose specific language.

Immediate action items (owner — due)
- Jordan: calendar invite for kickoff + agenda (today)
- Neha: test token distribution template + baseline script (by 5/19)
- Elliot: confirm staging hostname + initial dataset (by 5/19)
- Samira: share any internal security gates or blackout dates (asap)

Links / files
